verdict.rationale: Automated PR review is a fair capability to ask of a coding agent, but the evidence pack documents no PR review integration, GitHub app, or per-PR trigger. Headless mode for scripts and bots and the ACP agent mode are developer building blocks a user could wire into CI themselves, not a shipped automatic code-review feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
